candidates.label: Sum-divisible-by-4 check, then backtracking partition into 4 equal-sum groups; sticks sorted descending and pruned when the largest remaining stick alone exceeds the target side length.
Correct logic but prints capitalized 'Yes'/'No' instead of the required lowercase 'yes'/'no' -- deterministic mismatch, should fail even the existing test case.

Logically correct but omits the descending sort and the largest-stick pruning check -- the standard known-necessary optimization for this exact problem; without it, adversarial inputs with many similarly-sized sticks can blow up the branching factor and risk TLE even though the algorithm is not wrong.
